direction.name: OFFLINE SCALE STUDY: Villa Le Terrazze
direction.concept: A substantial Mediterranean villa of connected wings: a double-height living pavilion at the centre, a double-height entrance hall on the arrival court, two-storey bedroom wings whose upper floors step back to terraces, and an upper master suite projecting over the court.
hierarchy: Double-height living pavilion as the crown
West family wing with an upper bedroom floor stepping back to a terrace
East wing with the projecting upper master suite
direction.roofLanguage: Terracotta hips stepping down from the living pavilion.
direction.entrance: A grand double-height hall with a deep portal on a formal arrival court.
direction.outdoorLiving: A loggia off the living pavilion and a large pool south of the east wing.
direction.landscape: Broad shade trees and layered beds.

vision.ambitionEvidence: "a substantial luxury two-storey Mediterranean villa with six bedrooms"
vision.compositionIntent: A central double-height living pavilion and entrance hall between two two-storey wings; upper floors step back to terraces beside the pavilion.

signatureFeatures.intent: A double-height living room under the crowning roof.
Upper floors step back to bedroom terraces.
The master suite projects over the arrival court.

scale.scaleEvidence: Six bedrooms, seven bathrooms, two storeys, luxury: about 1,160 m² over 764 m² of footprint.

blocks.role: West family wing: kitchen, family room, media and stair
Upper bedroom floor, stepped back to a terrace by the pavilion
East wing: study, gym, guest suite and stair
Upper master suite projecting over the arrival court

openSpaces.role: Shaded loggia off the living pavilion
Pool reservation south of the east wing

pool.intentResolution: Stage 5 resolves conceptual reservation pool-garden (22×12 m at 19, 5) as one lap 14×4 m pool whose full deck envelope is 17.2×8.4 m, centred at 19.0, 4.4; promenade separation clears the accepted house front.

design.statement: OFFLINE SCALE STUDY: a large pool garden south of the east wing, shade trees along the arrival.
